name: Astra Afterburner
tagline: Point a stalled coding agent's research queue at your idle second plan
description: Scans a repository for questions worth investigating and holds them in a queue. When your coding assistant hits its usage ceiling for the day, that queue is handed to a browser session on your other paid plan instead of going nowhere, so a subscription you already fund does not sit idle.
author: SacredFolio
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
